_comment: The raw feat export has almost no real prereq data on 'Class & Racial' category feats (they're granted by the game's internal class tables, not by the prereqs shown here) — that's WHY a Fighter's general slot could show Ranger-only feats before this file existed. Every pool below is deliberately curated by hand against the real feat names in feats.json, verified during this session. 'categories' = feat.category values that are broadly allowed in this pool (e.g. any Combat feat for a Fighter). 'names' = exact additional feat names to allow. 'namePrefixes' = for feat families with Initiation/Proficiency/Mastery style variants, matches any feat name starting with this string. The 'general' pool (levels 1/3/6 + human bonus) intentionally excludes the whole 'Class & Racial' category — that category is ONLY reachable through these named bonus pools, which is what stops racial traits and other classes' chassis features from leaking into a general feat choice.

neverPickable._comment: Feats that should NEVER show up in any slot, general or bonus — either because they're pure racial traits with no meaningful 'choice' behind them, or because they're baked-in class chassis granted automatically the moment you take a level (not something you spend a slot on).
neverPickable.notes: Blindsight (10 foot radius) specifically comes bundled with the Warlock invocation Voidsense — it's never picked as its own feat. Damage Reduction 1/2 are Warlock-only chassis (auto-granted at levels 3/5) — they carry no real class-lock in the raw data (tagged 'Defensive' with zero prereqs, so without this exclusion ANY class could pick them), so they're excluded globally here and separately tracked in Warlock's autoFeatures so they still count toward any other feat's prerequisites.

wizardItemOrMetamagic.notes: No item-creation feats exist in the data at all — Haze's CXP-based scroll system (see Wizard class notes) apparently replaces that path entirely, so this pool is metamagic-only.
